records.name: Social Planning and Events Committee (SPEC)
records.summary: Penn Student Government's events branch. It runs eight committees that plan campus social events, concerts, films and speaker nights for students.
records.what_you_do: Students join one of the committees to help plan events. The SPEC site says committees need no application and students can join at any point in the semester.

schedule.text: A SPEC-wide info session is listed for Fall 2026 after the club fair, day not given. Each committee holds its own meetings.

first_step.how: Pick a committee on the SPEC site, join its listserv or email its directors, then come to a general meeting.
first_step.basis: The SPEC site says committees are application free and students can join at any point in the semester.

records.notes: Directory marks application required, but the SPEC site says committees need none, so the site wording is used. The Fall 2026 info session comes from the directory listing, with no month, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The site itself has no dated items.

records.name: Society for Creative Anachronism
records.summary: Penn's student chapter of a volunteer group that recreates crafts, music, dance and combat from before the 1600s. Members practice these skills and show them at events and demonstrations.
records.what_you_do: Members meet for period dance practice, craft nights and workshops. Guests without a PennCard are asked to RSVP to the chatelaine the Friday before an event.

schedule.text: Events are listed on the chapter site. A European dance practice is listed for Monday, Oct 12, 2026, 7 to 9 pm.

first_step.how: Email the chatelaine or use the contact page on the chapter site, then come to a listed event. Guests without a PennCard should RSVP first.
first_step.basis: The chapter site names the chatelaine as the first contact for newcomers and lists events publicly.

records.notes: The chapter site is the East Kingdom Bailiwick site. It names Penn only through events (a Penn Museum trip, a Fisher Fine Arts Library craft night), so the Penn tie rests on the directory entry. Audience set to public from the RSVP note for guests without a PennCard. Dated items on the site run through Oct 5, 2026.

records.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers (SHPE)
records.summary: A Penn chapter of a national group that supports Hispanic students and their allies in STEM. It runs social events, service projects and career-building events.
records.what_you_do: Members attend monthly general body meetings and take part in socials, service work and career events. Meetings are open to any year and major.

schedule.text: Monthly general body meetings in the evening. Upcoming dates listed: a social on Oct 16, 2026, a meeting on Oct 20, 2026, and a convention on Oct 28 to 31, 2026. Locations are posted later.

locations.label: Penn campus, location posted per event

first_step.how: Use the join link on the chapter site or email the chapter, then come to a general body meeting.
first_step.basis: Meetings are open to any year and major, and the site says you do not need to be an engineering major or Hispanic to join.

records.notes: Directory marks application required, while the chapter site says membership is open to all majors, so confirm the join form. The site lists pennshpe@engineering.upenn.edu and the directory lists shpe@engineering.upenn.edu; the directory address is used here, verify. The old directory website redirects to upennshpe.com.

records.name: Society of Undergraduate Mathematicians @ Penn
records.summary: A student group that promotes math on campus. It organizes events about the theory of math and about how math is used in the real world.
records.what_you_do: Members join the club's email list and Facebook group to hear about talks and events. Questions go through the site's contact form.

first_step.how: Join the club's email list (a Google Group) to get event notices. The directory marks the club as not accepting members, so confirm first.
first_step.basis: The email list is the way in, but the directory says the club is not accepting members and the site is being rebuilt, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site's newest dated item is a notice for the 2025 to 2026 school year saying a new site is in progress, and no events are listed. That is probably_active rather than active. last_sign_of_life is left out because no month is given. The directory marks the club as not accepting members, which conflicts with its open listserv.

records.name: Society of Women Engineers (Undergraduate)
records.summary: The Penn chapter of a national group for women in engineering. It runs career and skills events, outreach to local high school students, and work on gender equity in engineering.
records.what_you_do: Any Penn engineering student can attend events and join the mailing list. Students who want a bigger role apply to one of three committees: advocacy, educational outreach, or community development.

schedule.text: Committee applications for fall were due September 5, under a Fall 2026 heading. Board elections are held at the end of each fall semester.

first_step.how: Subscribe to the mailing list through the site's form, then attend an open event. Committee roles need an application.
first_step.basis: Events and the mailing list are open to any Penn engineer; only committee roles need an application.

records.notes: The directory marks the club as not accepting general members, but events and the mailing list are open to Penn engineers, so newcomer friendliness is 3. The Sept 5 deadline is read against the Fall 2026 heading in the directory. The site lists a 2026 to 2027 sponsorship package.

records.name: Soundworks Tap Factory
records.summary: Penn's student tap dance group. Members choreograph their own tap shows, mixing rhythm tap with Broadway, hip hop and jazz styles.
records.what_you_do: Members learn and perform in the group's two shows a year. New members join through the audition process.

schedule.text: Two shows a year. The spring show ran April 24 and 25, 2026 at 7:30 pm and 8:30 pm.

locations.label: Harold Prince Theater, Annenberg Center for the Performing Arts

first_step.how: Watch the Auditions page on the group's site, or email the group for audition details.
first_step.basis: Joining needs an audition, and the site does not yet give audition dates.

records.notes: The directory says Fall 2025 audition times were coming soon, and the site shows the April 2026 shows. Non-Penn attendance is not stated, so the audience stays students. Presidents' names are left out under the student privacy rule. The old directory website redirects to the webnode.page address.

records.name: Southeast Asian Circle at Penn (SEAC)
records.summary: Penn undergraduates who learn about Southeast Asian business and culture. They hold cultural events, run learning sessions on the region's markets, and do volunteer and consulting work for Southeast Asian communities.
records.what_you_do: Anyone can join general membership with no application. Executive board and committee roles need an application and an interview at the start of the semester.

first_step.how: Follow the club's Instagram account to learn how to join its GroupMe, then join general membership. No application is needed.
first_step.basis: General membership needs no application and is open regardless of background; only board and committee roles need an application and interview.

records.notes: No dated events and no club website are listed. The directory's accepting-members field is false, while the text says general membership is open, so the openness is stated from the text. Status is left unknown. The Instagram account was not read.

records.name: SPEC Concerts
records.summary: The SPEC committee that books and runs Penn's annual Spring Fling concert each April. Members plan the show, work on marketing and event details, and help with the concert.
records.what_you_do: Students join the Concerts Committee through its listserv or general meetings. The April concert is for Penn students and community members, so people outside Penn can attend.

schedule.text: The Spring Fling concert is held each April. The committee holds weekly or biweekly general meetings.

first_step.how: Join the Concerts Committee listserv or email the committee, then come to a general meeting.
first_step.basis: The committee is open to students of all years, and the site describes no application.

records.notes: The club site has no dated items; the April concert gives a month but no year. The directory lists the club as active with meetings, so probably_active. The directory marks an application as required, while the site says the committees are application free. No exact tag exists for concert booking; jam_sessions is the closest fit.

records.name: Spikeball Club at Penn
records.summary: A student group that teaches roundnet, a fast net game played with a small ball. Members play together at weekly hit-arounds for every skill level.
records.what_you_do: Players come to the Wednesday hit-arounds, 7:30 to 9:30 pm, and can join the group chat for updates.

schedule.text: Weekly hit-arounds on Wednesdays, 7:30 to 9:30 pm.

first_step.how: Come to a Wednesday hit-around, and join the group chat for updates.
first_step.basis: The club says hit-arounds are open to players of all skill levels.

records.notes: The club site lists a weekly schedule but no dated items, so probably_active. The directory marks an application as required, while the site describes none. Tennis and pickleball is the nearest tag for a net game. Non-Penn attendance is not stated.

records.name: Sports Analytics Group at Penn
records.summary: A student group that applies data analysis to sports performance. Members work on basketball, baseball and strength and conditioning, building models and visual reports for coaching staffs.
records.what_you_do: Members join a committee project and learn modeling, tracking and data visualization. Anyone who commits to learning and helping with projects is welcome.

first_step.how: Watch for the interest form posted on the club's Penn Clubs page at the start of each semester, or email the club.
first_step.basis: There is no formal application; anyone interested who commits to the projects is welcome.

records.notes: Dormant: the newest dated item on the site is a 2023 note about a baseball run, and no events are listed. The directory says the club is accepting members and the site describes a recurring semester interest form, which is not dated, so the group may still be running. Verify before showing it as current.

notes: 20 clubs, all read from the Penn Clubs API, with each club's own listed website checked. Two club pages returned HTTP 404 (SPEC Pop Up and SPEC-TRUM); those are noted on the records, not counted as blocked. Two old hosts redirected to new ones (SHPE to upennshpe.com, Soundworks to soundworkstapfactory.webnode.page) and the new hosts were read. Ten entries carry an INACTIVE flag in the directory and are held back as unknown with no summary, per the brief's rule for inactive entries: Sound Politicks, South Asia Society, South Asian Women's Space, Sparks Dance Company, SPEC Connaissance, SPEC Film Society, SPEC Jazz & Grooves, SPEC Pop Up, SPEC Sound and SPEC-TRUM. Several of those show some dated items on their own pages (SPEC Connaissance lists a 2025 to 2026 speaker season, SPEC Jazz & Grooves says shows are open to the public), so the owner may want to rule on the INACTIVE flag. Status counts: 5 active, 3 probably_active, 1 dormant, 1 unknown with a summary (SEAC), 10 unknown and held back. No student's personal name, phone or personal email was recorded; presidents' names were left out. Searches used: 0. Fetch calls used: 38, including 2 redirect hops.
